system.description: You rebuke one undead, demon, or creature of similar ilk within short range that you make a successful Intellect attack against. The affected creature does their best to accomplish a goal you specify in your rebuke, even if it would cause them or their allies harm, until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. Effort: Affect an additional foe (make a separate attack roll against each foe); you must give the same command to all affected creatures. Last action.
